text_block_list.text:
The spring Tenno Sho comes to an end
with a
cascade of cheers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик puts on an incredible race,
leaving a
strong impression on Tamamo
Cross.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Despite losing, her intimidating aura
shakes
Тамамо Кросс to her core.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Тамамо Кросс witnesses Супер Крик
race with a
seriousness she's never seen
before...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She then realizes that Супер Крик has
finally
found her own reason to run.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Огури Кэп awaits Супер Крик at her
next race,
the autumn Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
